cards.example_en: Silent mode kept his phone quiet during the whole film.
cards.example_zh: 静音模式让他的手机在整场电影里都没有出声。

cards.example_en: Teachers monitor the hallway during the lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 老师们在午休时间监视走廊。

cards.example_en: Our monthly test covers maths and science on the first Monday.
cards.example_zh: 我们的月考在第一个星期一考数学和科学。

cards.example_en: Winning the relay put the whole class in a happy mood.
cards.example_zh: 接力赛赢了以后，全班的心情都很好。

cards.example_en: Parents expect moral behaviour from children at the dinner table.
cards.example_zh: 父母希望孩子在餐桌上有合乎道德的举止。

cards.example_en: The book is useful; moreover, it is cheap.
cards.example_zh: 这本书有用，而且便宜。

cards.example_en: A mosquito bit me in the evening.
cards.example_zh: 晚上有蚊子叮了我。

cards.example_en: The class is mostly boys.
cards.example_zh: 这个班大多是男生。

cards.example_en: The gentle motion of the train soon put the baby to sleep.
cards.example_zh: 火车轻轻的晃动很快让宝宝睡着了。

cards.example_en: A kind comment can motivate a shy student in class.
cards.example_zh: 一句善意的评语就能激励班上害羞的学生。

cards.example_en: What was his motive for lying?
cards.example_zh: 他撒谎的动机是什么？

cards.example_en: Salt water damaged the motor of our small fishing boat.
cards.example_zh: 咸水损坏了我们那艘小渔船的发动机。

cards.example_en: Cyclists mount the last hill before the school gate.
cards.example_zh: 骑车的人在校门前登上最后一座小山。

cards.example_en: Any movement in the bushes made the rabbits run away.
cards.example_zh: 灌木丛里只要有动静，兔子就跑开了。

cards.example_en: The path was covered in mud.
cards.example_zh: 小路满是泥。

cards.example_en: The form asks for multiple phone numbers in case of emergency.
cards.example_zh: 表格要求填写多个应急电话号码。

cards.example_en: The play ends with a murder, so younger pupils should not watch.
cards.example_zh: 这出戏以一场谋杀结束，低年级学生不适合看。

cards.example_en: Daily swimming built muscle in his arms and back.
cards.example_zh: 每天游泳让他的手臂和背部长出了肌肉。

cards.example_en: A wild mushroom grew beside the path after three rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 连着下了三天雨以后，小路边长出了一朵野蘑菇。

cards.example_en: The musician tuned his guitar before the school concert.
cards.example_zh: 学校音乐会开始前，那位音乐家给吉他调了音。

cards.example_en: He hit the nail with a hammer.
cards.example_zh: 他用锤子敲钉子。

cards.example_en: The national flag flies above the town hall.
cards.example_zh: 国旗在市政厅上空飘扬。

cards.example_en: Please write your nationality on the form.
cards.example_zh: 请在表格上填写国籍。

cards.example_en: Pandas are native to China.
cards.example_zh: 熊猫原产于中国。

cards.example_en: The natural light in the art room is good for painting.
cards.example_zh: 美术室的自然光很适合画画。

cards.example_en: His uncle serves in the navy.
cards.example_zh: 他叔叔在海军服役。

cards.example_en: There is a nearby shop.
cards.example_zh: 附近有一家商店。

cards.example_en: Keep your desk neat.
cards.example_zh: 保持桌面整洁。

cards.example_en: She threaded the needle.
cards.example_zh: 她把线穿过了针。

cards.example_en: They will negotiate the price tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 他们明天将协商价格。

cards.example_en: Our neighbourhood is quiet at night.
cards.example_zh: 我们这一带晚上很安静。

cards.example_en: My nephew is five years old.
cards.example_zh: 我侄子五岁。

cards.example_en: Birds built a nest in the tree.
cards.example_zh: 鸟在树上筑了巢。

cards.example_en: Our best shot hit the net and never reached the goal.
cards.example_zh: 我们最好的一脚打在网上，球没有进。

cards.example_en: A weak network stopped the video call with our sister school.
cards.example_zh: 网络太差，和姐妹学校的视频通话中断了。

cards.example_en: It was cold; nevertheless we went out.
cards.example_zh: 天很冷，然而我们还是出门了。

cards.example_en: My niece loves drawing.
cards.example_zh: 我侄女喜欢画画。

cards.example_en: Helping others is a noble act.
cards.example_zh: 帮助别人是高尚的行为。

cards.example_en: The street outside is very noisy.
cards.example_zh: 外面的街道很吵。

cards.example_en: Birds fly to northern lakes when spring arrives.
cards.example_zh: 春天来临时，鸟儿会飞向北方的湖泊。

cards.example_en: The novelist signed my book.
cards.example_zh: 小说家给我的书签了名。

cards.example_en: Nowadays many students learn online.
cards.example_zh: 如今很多学生在网上学习。

cards.example_en: The keys were nowhere in the classroom.
cards.example_zh: 钥匙在教室里哪里都找不到。

cards.example_en: They visited a nuclear museum.
cards.example_zh: 他们参观了一座核博物馆。

cards.example_en: Squirrels hid every nut they found under the oak tree.
cards.example_zh: 松鼠把找到的每一颗坚果都藏到了橡树下面。

cards.example_en: The class learned about nutrition.
cards.example_zh: 这节课学习了营养知识。

cards.example_en: Our main objective is to improve quality.
cards.example_zh: 我们的主要目标是提高质量。

cards.example_en: In science class we observe how ice melts in a bowl.
cards.example_zh: 科学课上，我们观察冰块在碗里怎样融化。

cards.example_en: You must obtain permission first.
cards.example_zh: 您必须首先获得许可。

cards.example_en: The answer is obviously wrong.
cards.example_zh: 这个答案显然是错的。
